records.originalText: Don't bring that dirty dog through the kitchen.
records.finalText: Don't bring that dirty dog through the kitchen.

records.originalText: The chimney is belching black smoke.
records.finalText: The chimney is belching black smoke.

records.originalText: The image is not in focus.
records.finalText: The image is not in focus.

records.originalText: That movie star has many fans.
records.finalText: That movie star has many fans.

records.originalText: I found the film interesting.

records.originalText: The film was a great success.

records.originalText: The movie is X-rated.

records.originalText: When will the film be released?
records.finalText: When will the film be released?

records.originalText: That movie is suitable for people of all ages.
records.finalText: That movie is suitable for people of all ages.
records.rationale: Suitability for all ages is an unqualified viewing assurance without an identified film or reviewed classification context.

records.originalText: The film received favourable criticism.
records.finalText: The film received favourable criticism.
records.rationale: Received favourable criticism is a natural contextual reception description; the British adjective spelling is valid.

records.originalText: How does the film end?
records.finalText: How does the film end?
records.rationale: The complete film-ending question is natural direct speech and asserts no actual plot facts.

records.originalText: Their influence becomes greater every day, but they are uncreative and can't make value judgements.
records.finalText: Their influence becomes greater every day, but they are uncreative and can't make value judgements.
records.rationale: The unidentified group's uncreative and value-judgment limitations are an unsupported broad demeaning characterization.

records.originalText: The rumor spread all over the town.
records.finalText: The rumor spread all over the town.
records.rationale: Spread all over the town is a natural particular rumor-transmission account.

records.originalText: The rumor spread throughout the country.
records.finalText: The rumor spread throughout the country.
records.rationale: Repeats 49586's rumor-spread-through-a-place proposition with only geographic scale changed and no distinct rumor.

records.originalText: It is doubtful whether the rumor is true or not.
records.finalText: It is doubtful whether the rumor is true or not.
records.rationale: Doubtful whether the rumor is true correctly frames uncertainty using an embedded whether clause.

records.originalText: The astronaut had to conduct many experiments in the space shuttle.
records.finalText: The astronaut had to conduct many experiments in the space shuttle.
records.rationale: Had to conduct experiments in a space shuttle is a natural contextual work-obligation account without an actual mission claim.

records.originalText: Her application to join the party was rejected.
records.finalText: Her application to join the party was rejected.
records.rationale: Application to join being rejected is a natural contextual membership-decision account without a named political endorsement.

records.originalText: The blow caught him in the stomach.
records.finalText: The blow caught him in the stomach.

records.originalText: The family property was distributed among the relatives.
records.finalText: The family property was distributed among the relatives.
records.rationale: Distributed among relatives is a natural contextual family-property allocation passive without stating an inheritance rule.

records.originalText: The doctor did a good job on my leg.
records.finalText: The doctor did a good job on my leg.
records.rationale: Did a good job on my leg is a particular patient's subjective care assessment, without treatment details or a general efficacy guarantee.

records.originalText: The doctor knew how to cope with an emergency like this.
records.finalText: The doctor knew how to cope with an emergency like this.
records.rationale: Knew how to cope with an emergency is a natural contextual account of a doctor's competence, without instructing clinical actions.

records.originalText: The dead body was identified by a mole on the cheek.
records.finalText: The dead body was identified by a mole on the cheek.
records.rationale: The non-graphic identification account names a distinguishing cheek mole without actual identifying information about a real person.

records.originalText: The will was declared void by the court.
records.finalText: The will was declared void by the court.
records.rationale: Declared void by the court is a natural contextual legal-decision passive without giving legal advice or an actual ruling.

records.originalText: I can make nothing of it.
records.finalText: I can make nothing of it.
records.rationale: The context-free make-nothing-of-it comprehension-limit idiom overlaps existing over-my-head and beyond-my-understanding content.

records.originalText: The committee consists of fifteen people.
records.finalText: The committee consists of fifteen people.
records.rationale: Exact semantic repeat of the published committee-is-made-up-of-fifteen-members size statement, using consists and people.

records.finalText: The committee consists of scientists and engineers.
records.rationale: Repeats the published committee-composed-of-two-occupational-groups template with only the membership categories changed.

records.originalText: The committee consists of five members.
records.finalText: The committee consists of five members.
records.rationale: Another committee-size count variant adds no independent committee context beyond the published fifteen-member example.

records.originalText: The committee consists of seven scholars.
records.finalText: The committee consists of seven scholars.
records.rationale: Another counted committee-composition variant repeats established content without identifying a distinct body.

records.originalText: The committee is made up of ten members.
records.finalText: The committee is made up of ten members.
records.rationale: A further made-up-of counted committee-membership variant repeats the existing committee-size content.

records.originalText: A prize was given in honor of the great scientist.
records.finalText: A prize was given in honor of the great scientist.
records.rationale: Given in honor of a scientist is a natural contextual commemorative-prize passive without a specific historical assertion.

records.originalText: He was surprised to find the great artist's masterpiece hung on the wall upside down.
records.finalText: He was surprised to find the great artist's masterpiece hung on the wall upside down.
records.rationale: Surprised to find plus a masterpiece-hung complement forms a coherent particular upside-down-artwork discovery.

records.originalText: On hearing the bad news, she burst into tears.
records.finalText: On hearing the bad news, she burst into tears.
records.rationale: Repeats the published sad-news-caused-crying response in 44390 through an on-hearing time clause.

records.originalText: Are you ready to hear the bad news?
records.finalText: Are you ready to hear the bad news?
records.rationale: Ready to hear bad news is a natural complete preparatory question without a distressing event assertion.

records.originalText: Those candles burned the table.
records.finalText: Those candles burned the table.
records.rationale: Candles burning a table is a clear particular household damage account without harmful instructions.

records.originalText: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.
records.finalText: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.

records.originalText: Whoever wins the race will receive the prize.
records.finalText: Whoever wins the race will receive the prize.
records.rationale: Whoever wins correctly forms a free-relative subject in a complete contextual race-prize rule.

records.originalText: There were fifty entries for the race.
records.finalText: There were fifty entries for the race.
records.rationale: Fifty entries for the race is a natural contextual participation-count statement without a named public event claim.

records.originalText: Will you explain the rule to me?
records.finalText: Will you explain the rule to me?
records.rationale: Explain the rule to me is a complete natural clarification request.

records.originalText: The apple appeased my hunger temporarily.
records.finalText: The apple appeased my hunger temporarily.
records.rationale: Appeased my hunger is a valid formal collocation and temporarily correctly limits the personal apple-eating effect.

records.originalText: Making such a large sale is a feather in the salesman's cap.
records.finalText: Making such a large sale is a feather in the salesman's cap.
records.rationale: A feather in the salesman's cap is a conventional positive-achievement idiom anchored by a particular large sale.

records.originalText: Do you have any grounds for thinking so?
records.finalText: Do you have any grounds for thinking so?

records.originalText: That was why he entered the university.
records.finalText: That was why he entered the university.
records.rationale: That was why omits the reason for entering university, leaving the core explanation absent.

records.originalText: That kind of talk will get you nowhere.
records.finalText: That kind of talk will get you nowhere.

records.originalText: It cannot plausibly be argued that behaviour of such complexity derives entirely from instinct.
records.finalText: It cannot plausibly be argued that behaviour of such complexity derives entirely from instinct.

records.originalText: Bear in mind that, under such circumstances, we have no alternative but to find another buyer.
records.finalText: Bear in mind that, under such circumstances, we have no alternative but to find another buyer.

records.originalText: Such an event is quite common here.
records.finalText: Such an event is quite common here.

records.finalText: I am proud of having accomplished such a task.

records.finalText: Such an economic program will help the rich at the expense of the poor.

records.finalText: It is fortunate that you should have such a good friend.
records.rationale: Another fortunate-that-you-have-a-valued-person example repeats the existing relationship evaluation; emotive should adds no distinct situation.

records.originalText: The time when such things could happen is past.
records.finalText: The time when such things could happen is past.
records.rationale: Such things supplies no events, leaving the bygone-possibility judgment without its central content.

records.finalText: Do you think something like that will repeat itself?
records.rationale: Something like that has no event referent and the recurrence question lacks independently interpretable content.

records.originalText: The hen hatched five eggs.
records.finalText: The hen hatched five eggs.

records.finalText: There is little, if any, wine left in the bottle.

records.finalText: The hotel has an air of luxury.

records.finalText: That hotel is not all it's cracked up to be.
